19 Keyboard Macros ¶

In this chapter we describe how to record a sequence of editing commands so you can repeat it conveniently later.

A keyboard macro is simply a recording of keystrokes.

[Contents][Index]

Basic Use¶

Press F3 to start defining a macro and F4 to finish.
